body:
Connor OBrien: seeing some confusion w/ NorthPeak on retention numbers. what are we saying for logs vs payloads vs audit?
Aisha Rahman: for Hosted/Dedicated: operational request logs (metadata only) 14d. payloads not stored unless debug payload logging enabled  then 7d default.
Naomi Feldman: + audit logs are 365d. For Private: customer controls retention in their environment.
Connor OBrien: and what about the thing where Redwood engineers access the private control plane?
Hiro Tanaka: control-plane access logs (support access) are in Redwood systems  90d retention. audit stays 365d.
incident-bot: (note) please capture customer-facing commitments in SUP-1842 for traceability.
